name: rate-card-index
title: Rate card: base x ordered indices + premiums
description: Publishes a seller rate card so a buyer can evaluate prices locally while planning. Ports adcp#7955 (price_adjustments) with the changes that the PR #7955 review and the rate-card market survey asked for: an object container, an open dimension vocabulary, an explicit premium basis, seller-declared rounding, index-point rows, and provisional (capped) rows. The seller's quoted fixed_price and price_breakdown stay the binding contract.

extends.semantics: Planning aid. A buyer without this extension ignores it and uses fixed_price.
Signed card for one purchase. Provisional rows make the purchase price a ceiling that the seller re-quotes once it fixes the row.

promotion.rule: 2+ independent adopters with substantively similar cards for 90+ days, or 1 adopter plus a published market (JIC) rule

changelog.change: Current version: the pricing_option rate card and its commercial_terms binding, ported from adcp#7955, with the normative spec, the conformance suite, and the reference code, all pinned by the digest. Uses the kernel container ExtensionEntry with `data`, and the host properties `extensions` and `extensions_state`. The spec and manifest text follow the documentation style guide; the rules and their IDs are unchanged.
